decisions.decision: Subtypes are the ServiceKind slug verbatim; custom service and characteristic UUIDs are hard-coded literal v4 values outside Apple's base namespace.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed by the user at a blocking checkpoint. Seed-derived UUIDs were rejected because a later seed edit would silently orphan every installed custom service with a green test suite. A literal cannot drift. Pinned by a source-condition test forbidding uuid.generate under src/accessories/.

decisions.decision: An unknown or duplicated ignoredFaults slug refuses the configuration; the plugin does not start.
decisions.rationale: User decision against the recommendation, on consistency with validateConfig's existing refusals. Accepted risk: a typo leaves the pump unmonitored until fixed. Mitigation lives entirely in message quality, so naming the bad slug and enumerating all seven valid ones is a requirement of the decision, not a nicety.

decisions.decision: No sixth fault adapter for battery_health == 32; D-008 stays at five.
decisions.rationale: Resolves the open proposal in PROJECT.md against the adapter. The condition surfaces through the standard Battery service's StatusLowBattery, which Apple Home renders.

decisions.decision: RES-01 and RES-03 are split across Phase 3 and Phase 5.
decisions.rationale: Phase 3 ships field-validity plus the offline confirmation counter and adapter. Phase 5 owns the ~898s heartbeat, the two-missed-heartbeat rule, shadow silence, and restart persistence. Recorded in REQUIREMENTS.md delivery-split sub-bullets. Verified: no Phase 5 over-reach in any Phase 3 module.

context_notes: Phase 3 is implementation-complete and gate-complete in 73 commits: 998 unit tests (from 588), 62 Cucumber scenarios (from 35), 100% line/branch/function across src/, npm run check green on three consecutive runs at every gate. Code review converged over three iterations (2 blockers, then 2, then 0) and security closed 34/35 threats with threats_open: 0. The verifier confirmed 6/6 success criteria by executing the shipped code with its own probes plus two live mutation tests, not by reading summaries. The single most important carried lesson: four blockers, all false-normal paths, shipped inside a fully green suite at 100% coverage — coverage measures whether existing branches ran, not whether the right branches exist.
